name: SFPTECH
recent: SFP Tech 在 2026 年 11 月 20 日公布第三季度业绩，净利按年大增约八倍至 581 万令吉，带动九个月累计营收与盈利同步走高。同期，公司因员工行使 ESOS 而多次发行新股，并出现大股东与董事的股权变动申报。
notable: 第三季度净利按年大增约八倍至 581 万令吉，九个月累计营收与盈利同步增长。
公司因员工行使 ESOS 而多次发行新股，最新一批 401,850 股将于 2026 年 11 月 24 日上市。
独立非执行主席 Dato' Hamzah Bin Mohd Salleh 行使 20 万股 ESOS 期权。
risks: 大股东 MR LIM ZEE YANG 及 MR KEOH BENG HUAT 的股权变动申报显示持股出现变化。
董事 MISS TAN GEK IM 及 MR KEOH BENG HUAT 在闭市期外进行交易。
持续行使 ESOS 导致股本逐步扩大。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 3,910.5 万令吉，按季增长 48.8%，按年增长 36.4%；净利为 739.5 万令吉，按季增长 269.6%，按年增长 1,181.6%；净利率从上一季的 7.6% 升至 18.9%。

recent_en: SFP Tech reported third-quarter results on 20 Nov 2026, with net profit surging about eightfold year-on-year to RM5.81 million, lifting nine-month revenue and earnings. Meanwhile, the company issued new shares multiple times from ESOS exercises and saw substantial shareholder and director interest changes.
notable_en: 3Q net profit surged about eightfold year-on-year to RM5.81 million, with nine-month revenue and earnings also rising.
The company issued new shares multiple times from ESOS exercises, with the latest 401,850 shares to be listed on 24 Nov 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Hamzah Bin Mohd Salleh exercised 200,000 ESOS options.
risks_en: Substantial shareholders MR LIM ZEE YANG and MR KEOH BENG HUAT filed changes in their shareholdings.
Directors MISS TAN GEK IM and MR KEOH BENG HUAT traded outside the closed period.
Continued ESOS exercises have gradually enlarged the share base.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM39.105 million, up 48.8% QoQ and 36.4% YoY; net profit was RM7.395 million, up 269.6% QoQ and 1,181.6% YoY; net margin rose to 18.9% from 7.6% in the previous quarter.
